quest.title: Long Distance Love
quest.description: Godwin, a Knight of Favonius, is yearning for his lover who stayed in Mondstadt. He's looking for someone to deliver a letter to her...

talks.objective: Something seems to be troubling Godwin

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: ...Ugh, I am so ready to just get back to Mondstadt...

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: Oh, Traveler! Hi! Can I ask you a favor?

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: As you can see, I'm with the Knights, and I'm on patrol right now.

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: I told my girlfriend I would send her a letter before too long, just to let her know I'm safe and sound.

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: Then things got busy and I forgot all about it... dear me. Could you deliver this <color=#00E1FFFF>letter</color> to her for me? Her name's <color=#00E1FFFF>Glory</color>...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wait— Glory?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The blind girl... Dandelion Seed collector...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aha! You must be Godwin? Glory mentioned you!

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: Wha— How do you know Glory?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: She had us run an errand for her.

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: She made you run an errand, you say? I hope it wasn't anything dangerous...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: She just asked us to get her some Dandelion Seeds, that's all. She said by releasing them into the wind, they would convey her heart's desires to you.

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: Dandelion Seeds, eh? That does sound like my Glory alright.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hang on, she said you were supposed to be somewhere far away from Mondstadt?

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: Yes— erm, well that was the plan... Let me, uh, fill you in.

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: Did you hear about the time the Grand Master left Mondstadt and took four out of every five knights with him?

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: Right, well, I was one of the ones assigned to that expedition. But unfortunately... just as we were getting ready to set off, I realized I'd lost the keepsake that Glory gave me. By the time I was done looking for it, they'd already left...

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: I—I still haven't figured out how to catch up with them, and in the meantime I've just been milling around here...

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: I can't bring myself to go back to Mondstadt. I can only imagine what the knights would think of me if I just came crawling back...

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: Also... I promised Glory I would send her letters and gifts from all around the world. I said I would send her the world!

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: If she found out I'd never even made it out of Mondstadt...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You don't want to lose face.

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: Please, deliver this <color=#00E1FFFF>letter</color> to <color=#00E1FFFF>Glory</color> for me won't you? I bet she's worried sick about me.

response.speaker: Godwin
response.text: I can't thank you enough, Traveler! Please keep everything I just told you a secret though.

choices.text: Why not try the dandelion hotline?

response.speaker: Godwin
response.text: There is so much I want to say to Glory, far more than a handful of Dandelion Seeds could ever hope to carry.

response.speaker: Godwin
response.text: Thank you for taking her my letter. And remember, not a word about any of this!

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: Hello. I know that voice... Traveler! It's you, isn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: What brings you here today?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Someone told me to bring you this letter.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: A letter... for me? Who would do that...

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: ...Godwin.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: Have you seen him? I guess that must mean he's okay— Did he say when he'll be back?

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: Sorry, forget all that. I'm sure he must be far too busy to answer all these questions, I don't want to put any more pressure on him.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: But could you read the letter to me?

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: Quietly... No one needs to hear this but the two of us.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Okay.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: Wow, you read it so nicely... Is this something you do a lot?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's the end of the letter.

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: Liyue Harbor... Wow, Godwin really is seeing the world after all!

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: Thank you, I will treasure this letter. Next time you see <color=#00E1FFFF>Godwin</color>, do tell him I'm thinking of him.

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: Did you deliver my letter?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Glory sends her best wishes.

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: Phew... At least she's not mad at me after that long silence.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How do you know about Liyue Harbor when you've been milling around Mondstadt this whole time?

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: Ah, yes... All my stories are based on things the Grand Master has told me. He's been everywhere.

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: Anyway, thanks again. You have been a big help.

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: Here, take these Dandelion Seeds. I picked them myself.

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: Next time Glory asks you for more Dandelion Seeds, I'd appreciate it if you could help her out again.

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: Thank you for delivering my letter. *sigh* All I want to do is go back and see Glory... If only...

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: What is it? Is there something else you need to tell me?
